rationale_evidence.anchor: DimensionDiscovery is recursive. The system does not parse the initial question once and finish. It continually reconstructs the semantic space as the investigation develops.
rationale_evidence.statement: Argues Dimension Discovery must be recursive: a new question Q1 generated from prior discoveries re-enters the language-analysis pipeline (Q1 -> SemanticStructure1 -> D2), linking language analysis to the earlier progressive-investigation levels concretely (Level 0 initial parse, Level 1 relationship discovery, Level 2 duty/obligation, Level 3 consequence dimensions).

rationale_evidence.anchor: Why Parsing Engines Must Be Replaceable: Reason 1: Technological Evolution... Reason 2: Domain Adaptation... Reason 3: Research and Learning
rationale_evidence.statement: Gives three reasons parser implementations must remain replaceable: technology evolves (C/Sanskrit-style parsers today, LLM/neural parsers tomorrow), different domains need different specialized parsers (software vs legal vs medical), and the project must be able to learn from multiple grammatical/linguistic traditions without permanent dependency on any one.
